Final 2036 net reinvestment is exactly NOPAT2036 × 2.5% / 11%, so 2037 FCFF grows exactly 2.5%. This makes normalization explicit rather than giving the terminal period a hidden investment holiday. text.77ac265a24b6ab1420ea: The August letter's >1GW/year deployment ambition and new $20–25m/MW contracts are relevant evidence, but do not imply that all contracted power is active all year or that premium pricing applies to the whole installed base. An asset-light partnership can reduce Nebius cash capex, but partner ownership, profit sharing and gross-versus-net revenue recognition must change consistently.

text.aa0697aac0b9a7d4e21b: Servers/network accounting life moved from four to five years in 2026. The model must also test economic replacement at three/four/five years.
